Epoch-Scaled Multi-Hop Bonds

Agents open each peer link by posting a 0.08 POA bond that escalates by 0.04 POA for every extra link inside a 36-hour window. A farm of 80 fake accounts must lock 9.6 POA and wait the full decay before any recovery. Each must wander two attested prior paths and embed a unique beacon derived from a 14-line sonnet of epoch data; a missing beacon slashes 0.025 POA. Capital remains locked until real interaction density is proven, pricing out pure sybil farms.
